Backend API test run complete. Summary:

## Result: Backend CONVERGED — 14th consecutive run, 0 bugs, 0 fixes, 0 commits

**Precondition (proves no re-work needed):**
- `git diff --stat 2d7fb57..HEAD -- server/src client/src` → **EMPTY**
- `git status --porcelain -- server/src client/src` → **EMPTY**

Every commit since the baseline `2d7fb57` (2026-06-19) is an automated `checkpoint:`/`docs:` touching no source. 37 route files / 245 routes, unchanged. No new route files were added — the QA charter's only trigger for re-testing.

**Live smoke evidence** (ran the full suite anyway rather than trusting memory, using a freshly minted token via HTTP login):

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| sweep-all (245 routes) | 200×91 / 400×72 / 403×6 / 404×75 / 503×1 → **0 unintentional 5xx** |
| type-fuzz (1026 payloads) | 0 5xx / 0 err |
| tenant isolation | 22/22 (tenant_id + X-Tenant-Id spoof ignored; non-admin → 403) |
| happy-write | 3/3 (PATCH lead, PATCH invoice, estimate SKIP) |

The only non-2xx responses are all **intentional**: the single 503 is skip-trace refusing to run without `TRACERFY_API_KEY` (a paid API we correctly don't have), 6×403 are platform-admin-only gates, 400s are validation, 404s are missing-id/wrong-method. Nothing crashed; nothing was broken.

**No commits** — per charter, nothing broke and no source changed, so there's nothing to fix.

Deliverable written to `C:\tmp\api-test-results.txt`; resume and MEMORY.md updated for the next run. The backend has now converged on every axis across 14 runs — the only remaining gaps are frontend/out-of-charter (Esc-to-close keyboard nav = enhancement; EstimateBuilder at 375px = mobile, paused).
